title: Global Session Registry — Create the machine-wide session registry
description: After OPS-SHUTDOWN-001 removed all legacy shutdown paths, build the single aggregated session registry used by the Global Session Shutdown Manager. The registry lives at ~/.rpg-shutdown/session-registry.json (outside any project) and tracks per-project sessions with heartbeats, state, and TTL.
objectives: Design a Zod-validated JSON registry schema with version, machineId, updatedAt, projects, sessions, and policy
Implement atomic read/write/lease renewal and stale-session recovery in TypeScript
Create CLI commands to register, heartbeat, and release sessions from any directory
Default TTL to 60 seconds; expired heartbeats transition to UNKNOWN
Keep real shutdown disabled and run only in dry-run / no-op mode
success_criteria: Registry file can be created, read, and updated atomically without data races
CLI commands succeed from any working directory
Expired sessions become UNKNOWN after TTL expiry
No code outside scripts/shutdownManager/ calls shutdown
Evidence log documents schema, commands, and stale-session test results
dependencies: Zero unauthorized shutdown call sites outside scripts/shutdownManager/

invariants: Registry is an aggregated runtime view, not a source of truth; source of truth is the live process that heartbeats
forbidden_actions: Do NOT execute any shutdown command
Do NOT store user credentials or secrets in the registry
Do NOT use localStorage/sessionStorage for the registry

files_to_modify: package.json — add optional registry helper scripts if useful

unit_tests: Concurrent atomic write does not corrupt file
integration_tests: CLI register/heartbeat/release from a temp directory outside the repo
Two parallel registrations for different projects do not collide

documentation_updates: Add registry schema notes to src/docs/docs/plans/ops_shutdown_remaining_phases_plan.md if implementation diverges

notes.registry_location: Use path.join(os.homedir(), '.rpg-shutdown', 'session-registry.json'). Create the directory if it does not exist.
notes.schema: { version: string, machineId: string, updatedAt: ISO string, projects: Record<projectId, { status: string, sessions: Record<sessionId, { pid: number, heartbeatAt: ISO, state: SessionState, blockingReason?: string, owner: string, ttlSeconds: number }> }>, policy: { dryRun: boolean, userIdleThresholdSeconds: number, shutdownEnabled: boolean } }
notes.session_states: STARTING, RUNNING, IDLE, WAITING_FOR_USER, BLOCKED, QUEUED, COMPLETED, FAILED, STOPPING, UNKNOWN
notes.handoff: After this phase completes, the coordinator may queue OPS-SHUTDOWN-003 (decision engine) once canShutdown() tests cover the 16-row decision matrix.
